name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her university years, where she was studying mechanical engineering. A chance encounter with a local rally team needing assistance with their engine diagnostics sparked a passion that would define her career. Her meticulous approach quickly made her indispensable, and she rose through the ranks, working with various teams before finding a home at Boutsen VDS. 

As Chief Engineer, Elena emphasizes data-driven decisions and collaborative problem-solving. She believes in empowering her team to explore innovative solutions while maintaining a pragmatic focus on reliability and performance. Known for her unwavering dedication, she is a pillar of stability within the team, offering guidance and expertise to both seasoned veterans and promising newcomers alike. Elena is also known for her exceptional ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues quickly and accurately, a skill honed over decades in the field.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A woman of medium height, Elena carries herself with a quiet confidence and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten engineering notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply concentrated.
Insists on personally inspecting every critical component before a race.
